FAQ.title: Questions & Answers
FAQ.a1: An average savings of tens to hundreds of thousands of shekels over the life of the mortgage, depending on the loan amount and market conditions.
FAQ.q2: How long does the process take?
FAQ.a2: Usually between two weeks and a month, depending on document availability and bank approval.
FAQ.q3: Is there a commitment in the first meeting?
FAQ.a3: No, the initial consultation and eligibility check are provided for free and without any commitment.
FAQ.q4: Will it work for me if I don't have a large down payment?
FAQ.a4: Absolutely. There are creative financing solutions that responsibly combine complementary loans.
